resources.string: Allow Attaky Flasher to access the core?
F L A S H E R
Where should the firmware come from?
Browse and flash the newest releases from fwstore.attaky.com.
Flash images already on this device. Works offline.
Find your core on the network and send bins to the SD card. No cable.
Core found at %1$s. Send bins to its SD card, or update it over WiFi.
Looking for the core on your network…
No core answered. On the core open MENU → Start Web User Interface and leave it on that screen, with this phone on the same network.
Nothing answered on %1$s or the core\'s hotspot address. Check that the core is on the WebUI screen and on this same network, or type the address it shows below.
The core reports no SD card. Insert one and scan again.
The core answered at %1$s but refused the web login. Type the user and password it shows on its own screen.
Type the address the core shows on its screen first.
Nothing answered at %1$s. The core shows its own address on the WebUI screen — check it matches, and that the phone is on the same network.
Nothing downloaded yet. Grab firmware from the store — the merged image lands here ready to send.
Send to the core\'s SD card
%1$s is on the core\'s SD card.
The core\'s card refused the write on all %1$d tries. The card, not the app, is the flaky part here — try again, or reseat it in the core.
The core writes %1$s into a spare app slot and restarts into it. Its SD card and downloads are left alone.\n\nDo not unplug the core or close the app until it says the update finished.
%1$s is on the core. It is restarting into the new firmware.
%1$s holds no app image, so there is nothing for the core to boot.

On the core: MENU → Start Web User Interface. It shows an address on screen; this screen finds that core and posts the image to the card\'s root, where the core\'s SD flasher reads it. Tap OTA to install the image straight into the core\'s app slot over the same connection, for when the card is not to hand. If the scan misses the core, type the address it shows into Core address and tap CONNECT.
An image is half-way to the core\'s card. Leaving now aborts the transfer and the core discards the partial file.
Download firmware from the store first. A merged download lands in “Downloaded firmware” ready to flash.
Saved %1$s — open “Downloaded Firmware” to flash it offline.
Saved %1$s to %2$s on this device — it is ready in “Downloaded Firmware”.
Dark switches the page, the cards and the logo to the dark artwork.
Hide the status and navigation bars so the flasher owns the whole screen. Swipe from the edge to bring them back.
Scales every native screen: this page, the menu and the flasher.
Overrides the two text tones on the menu and the flasher. The store pages keep their own colours.
